sloka: उत्पातांस्ताननादृत्य राक्षसा बलगर्विताः ।यान्त्येव न निवर्त्तन्ते मृत्युपाशावपाशिताः ।। ७.६.५८ ॥
transliteration: utpātāṁstānanādṛtya rākṣasā balagarvitāḥ ।yāntyeva na nivarttante mṛtyupāśāvapāśitāḥ ।। 7.6.58 ॥

translations.english: Malyavan, Sumali, and Mali, all exceedingly mighty, were the leaders of those Rakshasas, just as fires are foremost in sacrifices.
